purpose: Analyst-authored checklist derived from the pinned official document; never passed to generation

rules.rule: 1,4 selects the first and fourth columns; 1-4 selects the first four columns.
!1-2 excludes the first two columns; Foo[2] selects the third column with duplicate name Foo.
_ denotes the last column; _-1 reverses the column order.
! followed by a regex excludes matching columns; --sort orders selected columns lexicographically by byte values.
--random shuffles selected columns and --seed supplies an integer random seed.
Names containing spaces or characters conflicting with selector syntax require quoting.
--no-headers treats first row as data; --delimiter is one character; --output writes a file rather than stdout.
